exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. Who is she?
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMDA NIMA KO'RINADI:

  Ayol SOYABONDAN ushlab, London ustidan
  UChIB kelmoqda. Bir qo'lida GILAM SUMKA
  (carpet bag), boshida gulli shlyapa.
  Pastda shaharning mo'rilari ko'rinadi.


JAVOB:

  'She is MARY POPPINS.'
  yoki to'liqroq:
  'She is Mary Poppins. She is a NANNY.'

  = 'U — Meri Poppins. U enaga.'


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  Uchta belgi Meri Poppinsni darhol
  tanitadi:

     1) SOYABON — u soyabon yordamida
        uchadi (filmning eng mashhur
        sahnasi)
     2) GILAM SUMKA — 3-mashqda undan
        narsalar chiqadi
     3) LONDON — 2-mashqning 1-bandi
        buni tasdiqlaydi


FILM HAQIDA QISQAChA:

  Disney musiqali filmi (1964), P. L.
  Traversning kitobi asosida.

  Benks oilasining ikki bolasi — Jane va
  Michael — enaga qidiryapti. Meri Poppins
  shamol bilan uchib keladi va sehrli
  narsalar qiladi.

  ⚠ Film 1910-yilgi Londonda bo'lib o'tadi.


DIQQAT — 'A NANNY':
  'a nanny' = enaga (bolalarga qaraydigan
  ayol)

  O'xshash so'zlar:
     'a babysitter' = vaqtinchalik
        qarovchi (kechqurunlari)
     'a nanny' = doimiy ishlaydigan enaga


DIQQAT — 'A CARPET BAG':
  'a carpet bag' = gilam matosidan
  tikilgan sumka

  ⚠ Filmda bu sumka SEHRLI — ichidan
  sumkadan katta narsalar chiqadi
  (3-mashqqa qarang).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a nanny     = enaga
  an umbrella = soyabon
  a carpet bag = gilam sumka
  to fly      = uchmoq
  magic       = sehrli

points.en: She is Mary Poppins. She is a nanny.
a carpet bag — the magic bag
points.noteUz:
⚠ Filmda bu sumka SEHRLI: ichidan sumkadan
KATTA narsalar chiqadi.

3-mashq aynan shu sahna haqida.

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  C London
  2  Jane va Michael
  3  A In a bank
  4  B a nanny
  5  C Tuesday


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'Which city does Mary Poppins live in?'
    → LONDON
    1-mashqdagi rasmda London ko'rinadi.
    7-mashqdagi xatda manzil ham London:
    '17, Cherry Tree Lane, London, England'.

 2  'What are the children's names?'
    → JANE and MICHAEL
    7-mashqdagi xat buni tasdiqlaydi:
    'My name is MICHAEL Banks... I have a
     sister called JANE.'

 3  'Where does George Banks work?'
    → IN A BANK
    ⚠ SO'Z O'YINI: familiyasi BANKS, ishi
    ham BANKDA!
    6-mashq: 'Mr Banks works in a BANK.'

 4  'What is Mary Poppins' job?'
    → A NANNY
    'a nurse' = hamshira;
    'a singer' = qo'shiqchi
    (u qo'shiq aytadi, lekin bu KASBI emas).

 5  'Which is Mary Poppins' day off?'
    → TUESDAY
    Filmda Meri Poppins ish shartlarini
    o'zi aytadi: har ikkinchi SESHANBA —
    uning dam olish kuni.


⚠ 3-BANDDAGI SO'Z O'YINI:

  'Mr BANKS works in a BANK.'

  Ingliz tilida bu — 'pun' (so'z o'yini).
  Familiya va kasb bir xil so'zdan.

  Boshqa misollar:
     Mr Baker — a baker (novvoy)
     Mr Fisher — a fisherman (baliqchi)


⚠ 2-BANDDAGI EGALIK:
  'the CHILDREN'S names'

  ⚠ 'children' — allaqachon KO'PLIK
  (noto'g'ri ko'plik), shuning uchun
  apostrof + 'S' qo'shiladi:
     children'S  ✓
     childrens'  ✗

  Solishtiring: 'the boys' names'
  (oddiy ko'plikda apostrof '-s' DAN KEYIN).


⚠ 4 va 5-BANDLARDAGI EGALIK:
  'Mary POPPINS' job'
  'Mary POPPINS' day off'

  ⚠ Ism '-s' bilan tugagani uchun faqat
  APOSTROF qo'yiladi (yana 's' qo'shilmaydi).


DIQQAT — 'A DAY OFF':
  'a day off' = dam olish kuni (ishdan
  bo'sh kun)

  'to take a day off' = bir kun dam olmoq


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a bank      = bank
  a nurse     = hamshira
  a day off   = dam olish kuni
  children's  = bolalarning

exercises.instructionEn: Tick which things Mary Poppins carries in her carpet bag.
exercises.instructionUz: Meri Poppins gilam sumkasida nimalarni olib yurishini belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'QQIZ RASM — BEShTASI TO'G'RI:

  ✓ hat stand    (shlyapa turgichi) —
                 KITOBDA BELGILANGAN
  ✗ scissors     (qaychi)
  ✗ shoes        (poyabzal)
  ✓ mirror       (oyna)
  ✗ TV           (televizor)
  ✓ tape measure (o'lchov lentasi)
  ✓ plant        (guldon)
  ✓ lamp         (chiroq)
  ✗ teapot       (choynak)


⚠ 'HAT STAND' — KITOBNING NAMUNASI:
  Kitobda uning yonida allaqachon ✓ bor.
  Qolgan 8 tasini o'zingiz belgilaysiz.


FILMDAGI MAShHUR SAHNA:

  Meri Poppins bolalar xonasiga kirib,
  gilam sumkasidan birin-ketin narsalarni
  chiqaradi:

     • SHLYAPA TURGIChI (hat stand) —
       birinchi bo'lib
     • OYNA (mirror) — katta oyna
     • GULDON (plant)
     • ChIROQ (lamp)
     • O'LChOV LENTASI (tape measure) —
       u bilan bolalarni o'lchaydi

  Jane va Michael hayron: sumka BO'Sh
  ko'rinadi, lekin ichidan sumkadan KATTA
  narsalar chiqadi!


⚠ 'TV' — TARIXIY TUZOQ:

  Film 1910-YILGI Londonda bo'lib o'tadi.
  Televizor esa 1920-30-YILLARDA ixtiro
  qilingan.

  Ya'ni o'shanda televizor UMUMAN YO'Q edi!

  ⚠ Bu — 84-betdagi 'gold watch' va
  'garage' bilan BIR XIL turdagi tuzoq.
  Kitob ataylab zamonaga mos kelmaydigan
  narsani qo'yadi.


QOLGAN NOTO'G'RI JAVOBLAR:

  ✗ SCISSORS (qaychi) — sumkadan
    chiqmaydi.
  ✗ SHOES (poyabzal) — chiqmaydi.
  ✗ TEAPOT (choynak) — sumkadan chiqmaydi.
    (Choy sahnasi bor, lekin u Albert
     amakinikida bo'lib o'tadi.)


DIQQAT — DOIM KO'PLIKDA BO'LADIGAN SO'ZLAR:

  'SCISSORS' — doim ko'plikda!
     'The scissors ARE on the table.'  ✓
     'The scissors IS ...'             ✗
     'a pair of scissors' = bir juft
        qaychi

  'SHOES' — juft narsa:
     'a pair of shoes' = bir juft poyabzal

  Shunga o'xshash: trousers, glasses,
  jeans.


DIQQAT — 'A TAPE MEASURE':
  'a tape measure' = o'lchov lentasi

  ⚠ Filmda Meri Poppins u bilan bolalarni
  o'lchaydi va lentada xarakter yozuvi
  chiqadi ('Extremely stubborn and
  suspicious').


DIQQAT — 'A HAT STAND':
  'a hat stand' = shlyapa turgichi
  (shlyapa osiladigan tik turgich)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a hat stand = shlyapa turgichi
  scissors    = qaychi (DOIM ko'plikda)
  a mirror    = oyna
  a tape measure = o'lchov lentasi
  a plant     = o'simlik, guldon
  a lamp      = chiroq
  a teapot    = choynak
  to carry    = olib yurmoq

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the advertisement below with the following words: rosy, kind, games, children, pretty, give, sing
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (7 ta so'z):
  rosy, kind, games, children, pretty,
  give, sing


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  children
  2  rosy
  3  kind
  4  pretty
  5  games
  6  sing
  7  give


TO'LIQ E'LON:

  'WANTED: A nanny for two adorable
   CHILDREN. She must have ROSY cheeks and
   be KIND and PRETTY. She must play GAMES.
   She must SING songs and GIVE treats.'

  Tarjimasi:
  'KERAK: ikki yoqimtoy BOLA uchun enaga.
   Uning yuzlari QIZG'ISh bo'lishi, MEHRIBON
   va ChIROYLI bo'lishi kerak. U O'YINLAR
   o'ynashi kerak. U qo'shiq AYTIShI va
   shirinlik BERIShI kerak.'


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — SO'Z TURIGA QARANG:

  1  'for two adorable 1)......'
     'two' va 'adorable' dan keyin —
     KO'PLIK OT kerak
     Ro'yxatdagi ikkita ot: children, games
     'adorable' (yoqimtoy) odam haqida
     → CHILDREN

  2  '2)...... cheeks'
     'cheeks' dan oldin — SIFAT
     ⚠ 'ROSY cheeks' = qizg'ish yuzlar
     (turg'un birikma)

  3, 4  'be 3)...... and 4)......'
     'be' dan keyin — SIFAT
     Qolgan sifatlar: kind, pretty
     ⚠ Filmdagi qo'shiqda tartib:
     'You must be KIND... and fairly PRETTY'
     → KIND, keyin PRETTY

  5  'She must play 5)......'
     'play' dan keyin — OT
     → GAMES ('play games' = o'yin
       o'ynamoq)

  6  'She must 6)...... songs'
     'must' dan keyin — FE'L
     'songs' bilan → SING ('sing songs')

  7  'and 7)...... treats'
     'treats' bilan → GIVE ('give treats' =
       shirinlik bermoq)


⚠ 'MUST' NING TAKRORLANIShI:

  E'londa 'must' TO'RT marta ishlatilgan:
     'She MUST have ...'
     'She MUST play ...'
     'She MUST sing ...'

  ⚠ 'must' dan keyin DOIM ASOSIY shakl:
     'must HAVE'  ✓
     'must HAS'   ✗
     'must TO have' ✗

  ⚠ 3-shaxsda ham '-s' QO'ShILMAYDI:
     'She must sing.'   ✓
     'She musts sing.'  ✗

  (Unit 14 grammatikasi.)


⚠ FILMDAGI QO'ShIQ:

  Bu e'lon filmda Jane va Michael yozgan
  e'longa asoslangan. Ular qo'shiq
  ko'rinishida e'lon yozishadi:

     'Wanted a nanny for two adorable
      children...'
     'If you want this choice position,
      have a cheery disposition...'
     'Rosy cheeks, no warts!'
     'Play games, all sorts...'
     'You must be kind, you must be witty,
      very sweet and fairly pretty...'


DIQQAT — 'WANTED':
  'WANTED' — e'lonlarda 'kerak', 'izlanadi'
  ma'nosida.

  'WANTED: a teacher' = O'qituvchi kerak

  ⚠ Bu — MAJHUL nisbatning qisqargan shakli
  ('a nanny IS WANTED').


DIQQAT — 'A TREAT':
  'a treat' = shirinlik, mazza qiladigan
  narsa; suyuntiruvchi narsa

  'to give treats' = shirinlik bermoq


DIQQAT — 'ADORABLE':
  'adorable' = yoqimtoy, jonli
  (odatda bolalar va hayvonlar haqida)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  WANTED     = kerak (e'londa)
  adorable   = yoqimtoy
  rosy       = qizg'ish
  a cheek    = yuz (bet)
  kind       = mehribon
  pretty     = chiroyli
  a treat    = shirinlik
  to play games = o'yin o'ynamoq

items.sentence: WANTED: A nanny for two adorable ..................... .
items.uz: KERAK: ikki yoqimtoy bola uchun enaga.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'two' va 'adorable' dan keyin KO'PLIK OT
kerak.

Ro'yxatda ikkita ot bor: children, games.
'adorable' (yoqimtoy) ODAM haqida → CHILDREN.

'child' → 'CHILDREN' (noto'g'ri ko'plik).

'cheeks' dan OLDIN — SIFAT.

⚠ 'ROSY cheeks' = qizg'ish yuzlar
(TURG'UN BIRIKMA, sog'lom ko'rinishni
bildiradi).

'a rose' (atirgul) so'zidan yasalgan.

'be' dan keyin — SIFAT.

⚠ Filmdagi qo'shiqda tartib:
'You must be KIND, you must be witty, very
sweet and fairly PRETTY.'
→ KIND birinchi.

'kind' = mehribon (XARAKTER).

items.sentence: and be kind and ..................... .   (ikkinchi bo'sh joy)

commonMistake.whyUz:
Qolgan sifat → PRETTY.

'pretty' = chiroyli (TASHQI KO'RINISH).

⚠ Bir gapda XARAKTER (kind) va TASHQI
KO'RINISH (pretty) — Unit 4 ning farqi.

'play' dan keyin — OT.

'play GAMES' = o'yin o'ynamoq.

⚠ 'must' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
'must PLAY' ✓ / 'must PLAYS' ✗

'must' dan keyin — FE'L; 'songs' bilan
keladigan fe'l → SING.

'sing SONGS' — turg'un birikma.

sing → sang → sung.

Qolgan fe'l → GIVE.

'give TREATS' = shirinlik bermoq.

'a treat' = shirinlik, mazza qiladigan narsa.
give → gave → given.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the sentences with words from the box: laughing, painting, singing, working
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni quyidagi so'zlar bilan to'ldiring: laughing, painting, singing, working
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (4 ta so'z):
  laughing, painting, singing, working


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  Mary Poppins likes SINGING.
  Bert likes PAINTING.
  Uncle Albert likes LAUGHING.
  Mr Banks likes WORKING.

  Tarjimasi:
  Meri Poppins qo'shiq aytishni yoqtiradi.
  Bert rasm chizishni yoqtiradi.
  Albert amaki kulishni yoqtiradi.
  Janob Benks ishlashni yoqtiradi.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

  MARY POPPINS → SINGING
     Butun film MUSIQALI — Meri Poppins
     doim qo'shiq aytadi
     ('A Spoonful of Sugar',
      'Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious').

  BERT → PAINTING
     Bert — ko'cha rassomi ('a screever').
     U yo'lakka bo'r bilan rasm chizadi.
     Uning rasmlariga kirib ketish mumkin —
     filmning sehrli sahnasi.

  UNCLE ALBERT → LAUGHING
     ⚠ Albert amaki KULGANDA HAVOGA
     KO'TARILADI!
     U shiftga chiqib qoladi va u yerda choy
     ichadi ('I Love to Laugh' qo'shig'i).

  MR BANKS → WORKING
     Janob Benks — bank xodimi, doim ishda.
     U bolalariga vaqt ajratmaydi — filmning
     asosiy muammosi.

     Film oxirida u o'zgaradi va bolalari
     bilan varrak uchiradi.


⚠ GRAMMATIKA — 'LIKE + V-ING':

  'Mary Poppins likes SINGING.'

  ⚠ 'like' dan keyin '-ING' shakli:
     'like SINGING'   ✓
     'like SING'      ✗
     'like TO SING'   ✓ (bu ham to'g'ri,
        lekin ma'nosi biroz boshqa)

  Shunga o'xshash fe'llar:
     like / love / enjoy / hate + V-ING
     'I hate EATING chocolate.'
        (3-nazorat testi)


⚠ '-ING' QO'ShILIShI:
  sing → singING
  paint → paintING
  laugh → laughING
  work → workING

  Bu to'rttasida hech narsa o'zgarmaydi.

  Solishtiring:
     make → makING ('e' tushadi)
     run → runNING (undosh ikkilanadi)


⚠ 'LIKES' — '-S' QO'ShILADI:
  'Mary Poppins LIKES ...' (3-shaxs birlik)
  'Bert LIKES ...'
  'Uncle Albert LIKES ...'
  'Mr Banks LIKES ...'

  Hammasi BIRLIK, shuning uchun 'likeS'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to laugh    = kulmoq
  to paint    = rasm chizmoq
  a screever  = ko'cha rassomi
  chalk       = bo'r
  to float    = suzmoq (havoda)
  a ceiling   = shift

pairs.whyUz:
Butun film MUSIQALI — Meri Poppins doim
qo'shiq aytadi ('A Spoonful of Sugar',
'Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious').

⚠ 'like + V-ING': 'likes SINGING' ✓ /
'likes SING' ✗

Bert — KO'CHA RASSOMI ('a screever').
U yo'lakka BO'R bilan rasm chizadi.

Uning rasmlariga kirib ketish mumkin — bu
filmning eng sehrli sahnasi.

⚠ Albert amaki KULGANDA HAVOGA KO'TARILADI!

U shiftga chiqib qoladi va u yerda choy
ichadi ('I Love to Laugh' qo'shig'i).

3-mashqdagi 'teapot' aynan shu sahnaga
ishora — lekin u sumkadan chiqmagan.

Janob Benks — bank xodimi, doim ishda.
U bolalariga vaqt ajratmaydi — bu filmning
asosiy MUAMMOSI.

Film oxirida u o'zgaradi va bolalari bilan
VARRAK uchiradi (7-mashq: 'I like flying
KITES').

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the description of Mr Banks. Use the words below: tall, hat, umbrella, bank
exercises.instructionUz: Janob Benksning tasvirini to'ldiring: tall, hat, umbrella, bank
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (4 ta so'z):
  tall, hat, umbrella, bank


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  bank
  2  tall
  3  hat
  4  umbrella


TO'LIQ TASVIR:

  'Mr Banks works in a BANK. He's quite
   TALL, about six foot. He wears a bowler
   HAT and a suit. He always carries an
   UMBRELLA.'

  Tarjimasi:
  'Janob Benks bankda ishlaydi. U ancha
   baland bo'yli, taxminan olti fut. U
   kotelok shlyapa va kostyum kiyadi. U doim
   soyabon olib yuradi.'


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1  'works in a(n) 1)......'
     Ish JOYI kerak → BANK
     ⚠ So'z o'yini: Mr BANKS — a BANK
     (2-mashqning 3-bandi)

  2  'He's quite 2)......, about six foot.'
     ⚠ KALIT: 'about SIX FOOT' — BO'Y!
     → TALL

  3  'He wears a bowler 3)......'
     ⚠ 'a BOWLER HAT' = kotelok shlyapa
     (turg'un birikma)
     → HAT

  4  'He always carries a(n) 4)......'
     'carry' bilan → UMBRELLA


⚠ 'SIX FOOT' — INGLIZ O'LChOVI:

  1 foot = 30,48 sm
  6 foot = taxminan 183 sm

  ⚠ Bo'y haqida gapirganda 'FOOT'
  (birlikda) ishlatiladi, 'feet' emas:
     'He's six FOOT tall.'  ✓ (so'zlashuv)
     'He's six FEET tall.'  ✓ (rasmiy)

  'foot' ning ko'pligi — FEET (noto'g'ri
  ko'plik).


⚠ 'A(N)' — KITOBNING ISHORASI:

  Kitob 'a(n)' deb yozgan, chunki javob
  UNLI yoki UNDOSh tovush bilan
  boshlanishi mumkin:

     'in a BANK'      (undosh → a)
     'an UMBRELLA'    (unli → an)

  Bu — o'quvchiga yordam.


⚠ 'A BOWLER HAT':

  'a bowler hat' = kotelok (qattiq, dumaloq
  shlyapa)

  1910-yillarda London ish odamlarining
  ramzi edi: kotelok + kostyum + soyabon.

  Janob Benks — aynan shu qiyofada.


⚠ 'CARRY' va 'WEAR' FARQI:

  WEAR = kiyib turmoq (kiyim, shlyapa)
     'He WEARS a bowler hat and a suit.'
  CARRY = olib yurmoq (qo'lda)
     'He CARRIES an umbrella.'

  ⚠ Soyabon KIYILMAYDI — OLIB YURILADI!


⚠ 'QUITE':
  'He's QUITE tall.' = ancha baland bo'yli

  'quite' — kuchaytiruvchi, lekin 'very'
  dan zaifroq:
     a bit tall < quite tall < very tall


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  quite       = ancha
  a foot (feet) = fut (o'lchov, 30,48 sm)
  a bowler hat = kotelok shlyapa
  a suit      = kostyum
  to carry    = olib yurmoq

commonMistake.whyUz:
Ish JOYI kerak → BANK.

⚠ SO'Z O'YINI: Mr BANKS — a BANK
(2-mashqning 3-bandi ham shu haqida).

items.uz: U ancha baland bo'yli, taxminan olti fut.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ KALIT: 'about SIX FOOT' — BO'Y! → TALL.

1 foot = 30,48 sm; 6 foot ≈ 183 sm.

⚠ Bo'y haqida 'six FOOT' (birlikda) deyish
mumkin; 'six FEET' ham to'g'ri (rasmiyroq).

items.sentence: He wears a bowler ..................... and a suit.
items.uz: U kotelok shlyapa va kostyum kiyadi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'a BOWLER HAT' = kotelok (qattiq, dumaloq
shlyapa) — TURG'UN BIRIKMA.

1910-yillarda London ish odamlarining ramzi:
kotelok + kostyum + soyabon.

'carry' bilan → UMBRELLA.

⚠ 'CARRY' va 'WEAR' FARQI:
  WEAR = kiyib turmoq (shlyapa, kostyum)
  CARRY = olib yurmoq (qo'lda)
Soyabon KIYILMAYDI — OLIB YURILADI!

⚠ 'AN umbrella' — unli tovush ('a(n)'
kitobning ishorasi).

exercises.instructionEn: Complete Michael's letter to a pen-friend below. Use the words in the list: kind, funny, father's, kites, blue, short, bank, fair, Uncle, nanny
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (10 ta so'z):
  kind, funny, father's, kites, blue, short,
  bank, fair, Uncle, nanny


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  short
   2  fair
   3  blue
   4  father's
   5  bank
   6  nanny
   7  kind
   8  funny
   9  kites
  10  Uncle


TO'LIQ XAT:

──────────────────────────────────
  17, Cherry Tree Lane
  London
  England

  Dear Mario,

  My name is Michael Banks. I am eight
  years old. I'm SHORT and slim with FAIR
  hair and BLUE eyes.

  My FATHER'S name is George and he works
  in a BANK. I have a sister called Jane.
  I also have a NANNY called Mary Poppins.
  She's very KIND and FUNNY.

  I like flying KITES and going to visit
  UNCLE Albert.

  Write back and tell me about yourself.

  Best wishes,
  Michael
──────────────────────────────────


TARJIMASI:

  'Aziz Mario,

   Mening ismim Maykl Benks. Sakkiz
   yoshdaman. Men past bo'yli va ozg'inman,
   och rangli sochim va ko'k ko'zlarim bor.

   Otamning ismi Jorj, u bankda ishlaydi.
   Jeyn ismli opam bor. Yana Meri Poppins
   ismli enagam bor. U juda mehribon va
   kulgili.

   Men varrak uchirishni va Albert amakinikiga
   borishni yoqtiraman.

   Javob yoz va o'zing haqingda gapir.

   Salom bilan,
   Maykl'


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1  'I'm 1)...... and slim'
     'slim' (ozg'in) bilan yonma-yon —
     GAVDA tasviri.
     Maykl SAKKIZ yoshda → SHORT
     (past bo'yli)

  2  'with 2)...... hair'
     'hair' dan oldin — RANG → FAIR

  3  'and 3)...... eyes'
     'eyes' dan oldin — RANG → BLUE

  4  'My 4)...... name is George'
     ⚠ 'name' dan oldin — EGALIK shakli
     Ro'yxatdagi yagona egalik shakli
     → FATHER'S

  5  'he works in a 5)......'
     Ish joyi → BANK
     (2 va 6-mashqlar bilan bir xil)

  6  'I also have a 6)...... called Mary
     Poppins'
     Meri Poppinsning kasbi → NANNY
     (2-mashqning 4-bandi)

  7, 8  'She's very 7)...... and 8)......'
     'She's very' dan keyin — SIFAT
     Qolgan sifatlar: kind, funny
     → KIND va FUNNY

  9  'I like flying 9)......'
     ⚠ 'FLY A KITE' = varrak uchirmoq
     → KITES

 10  'going to visit 10)...... Albert'
     Ism oldidan → UNCLE (bosh harf bilan!)


⚠ 4-BAND — ENG OSON:

  Ro'yxatda 10 ta so'z bor, lekin faqat
  BITTASI EGALIK shaklida: 'father'S'
  (apostrof + s).

  'My ...... name is George' — 'name' dan
  oldin egalik kerak → FATHER'S.


⚠ 10-BAND — BOSh HARF:

  'UNCLE Albert' — ism bilan birga
  ishlatilganda BOSh HARF bilan.

     'UNCLE Albert'  ✓ (ism)
     'my uncle'      ✓ (oddiy so'z)

  Shunga o'xshash: Aunt Mary, Doctor Smith.

  ⚠ Kitob ro'yxatda 'Uncle' ni allaqachon
  BOSh HARF bilan bergan — bu ishora!


⚠ 9-BAND — 'FLY A KITE':

  'to fly a kite' = varrak uchirmoq

  ⚠ Filmning OXIRGI sahnasi: butun oila
  varrak uchiradi ('Let's Go Fly a Kite'
  qo'shig'i).

  5-mashqda 'Mr Banks likes WORKING' edi —
  film oxirida u o'zgarib, bolalari bilan
  varrak uchiradi.


⚠ XAT TUZILIShI (do'stona xat):

  MANZIL — o'ng yuqorida
     '17, Cherry Tree Lane, London, England'
  MUROJAAT — 'Dear Mario,' (VERGUL bilan)
  YAKUN — 'Write back and tell me about
     yourself.'
  IMZO — 'Best wishes, Michael'

  Coursebook 115-bet, 11-mashq bilan bir
  xil qolip!


DIQQAT — 'A PEN-FRIEND':
  'a pen-friend' = xat orqali tanishgan
  do'st (qalam do'sti)

  AmE: 'a pen pal'


DIQQAT — 'WRITE BACK':
  'Write back!' = javob yoz!
  'back' — qaytarish ma'nosini beradi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a pen-friend = xat do'sti
  slim        = ozg'in
  a kite      = varrak
  to fly a kite = varrak uchirmoq
  funny       = kulgili
  to write back = javob yozmoq
  yourself    = o'zingiz haqingizda

commonMistake.whyUz:
'slim' (ozg'in) bilan yonma-yon — GAVDA
tasviri.

Maykl SAKKIZ yoshda → SHORT (past bo'yli).

⚠ 6-mashq bilan solishtiring: otasi 'TALL'
(olti fut).

'hair' dan OLDIN — RANG → FAIR
(och rangli, sarg'ish).

84-betda ham bor edi: Feb 'FAIR hair'.

⚠ 'fair' ning boshqa ma'nosi — 'adolatli'.

'eyes' dan OLDIN — RANG → BLUE.

⚠ 'eyes' — KO'PLIK:
'What colour ARE your eyes?'

⚠ ENG OSON BAND!

Ro'yxatda 10 ta so'z bor, lekin faqat BITTASI
EGALIK shaklida: 'father'S' (apostrof + s).

'name' dan oldin egalik kerak → FATHER'S.

Ish joyi → BANK.

2-mashqning 3-bandi va 6-mashq bilan BIR XIL:
'Mr BANKS works in a BANK' — so'z o'yini.

items.sentence: 6  I also have a ..................... called Mary Poppins.
items.uz: Yana Meri Poppins ismli enagam bor.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Meri Poppinsning KASBI → NANNY.

2-mashqning 4-bandi tasdiqlaydi.

'a ... CALLED Mary Poppins' = Meri Poppins
ISMLI ...
(o'xshash: 'a sister CALLED Jane').

'She's very' dan keyin — SIFAT.

Qolgan sifatlar: kind, funny.

'kind' = mehribon (XARAKTER).
4-mashqda ham bor edi: 'She must be KIND.'

Qolgan sifat → FUNNY (kulgili).

Ikkalasi ham XARAKTER haqida —
'What IS she LIKE?' savolining javobi.

⚠ 'to FLY A KITE' = varrak uchirmoq.

Filmning OXIRGI sahnasi: butun oila varrak
uchiradi ('Let's Go Fly a Kite').

5-mashqda 'Mr Banks likes WORKING' edi —
film oxirida u o'zgaradi.

'like + V-ING': 'like FLYING' ✓

Ism oldidan → UNCLE.

⚠ BOSH HARF bilan, chunki ism bilan birga:
  'UNCLE Albert'  ✓ (ism)
  'my uncle'      ✓ (oddiy so'z)

Kitob ro'yxatda 'Uncle' ni allaqachon BOSH
HARF bilan bergan — bu ISHORA!

exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI OChIQ SAVOL:

 1  'Why is Mary Poppins a good nanny?'
    = Nega Meri Poppins yaxshi enaga?

 2  'What are the qualities you like most
     in Mary Poppins?'
    = Meri Poppinsda sizga eng ko'p qaysi
      fazilatlar yoqadi?


⚠ BU MAShQ OChIQ JAVOBLI:
  To'g'ri javob yo'q — o'z fikringizni
  aytishingiz kerak.


1-SAVOL uchun NAMUNA JAVOBLAR:

  'Mary Poppins is a good nanny because
   she is kind and funny.'
  (Meri Poppins yaxshi enaga, chunki u
   mehribon va kulgili.)

  'She is a good nanny because she plays
   games with the children.'

  'She is a good nanny because she teaches
   the children to be happy.'

  'She is a good nanny because she helps
   the family to be together again.'

  ⚠ 4-mashqdagi e'lon — tayyor ro'yxat!
     'She must have rosy cheeks and be KIND
      and PRETTY. She must play GAMES. She
      must SING songs and GIVE treats.'

     Meri Poppins bularning HAMMASINI
     bajaradi.


2-SAVOL uchun FOYDALI SIFATLAR:

  kind        = mehribon
  funny       = kulgili
  patient     = sabrli
  cheerful    = quvnoq
  strict      = qattiqqo'l
  magical     = sehrli
  clever      = aqlli
  caring      = g'amxo'r
  responsible = mas'uliyatli

  QOLIP:
     'I like her ...... most because ... .'
     'The quality I like most is ... .'

  Masalan:
     'I like her kindness most because she
      always helps the children.'


⚠ 'A QUALITY':
  'a quality' = fazilat, xususiyat

  'What qualities do you like?' = qanday
  fazilatlar yoqadi?

  ⚠ Bu so'z XARAKTER haqida ('What is she
  LIKE?'), tashqi ko'rinish emas.


⚠ 84-BET BILAN BOG'LIQ:

  Notr-Dam varaqasidagi muhokama savoli
  ham shunday edi:
     'What are the things you like most
      about your best friend?'

  Ikkala film ham XARAKTER va FAZILAT
  haqida.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a quality   = fazilat, xususiyat
  patient     = sabrli
  cheerful    = quvnoq
  strict      = qattiqqo'l
  caring      = g'amxo'r
  responsible = mas'uliyatli
  kindness    = mehribonlik

points.en: 1  Why is Mary Poppins a good nanny?

⚠ 4-mashqdagi e'lon — TAYYOR RO'YXAT:

Meri Poppins bularning HAMMASINI bajaradi.
